policy_note: Rechecked detailed procedures on 2026-10-07: internal closes are generally four weeks before external close for major ARC/NHMRC schemes, one week for other Australian schemes, and two weeks for overseas schemes, unless otherwise advised. The FAQ instead states one week for domestic applications without the major-scheme distinction and still names Research Professional, while the current funding-database page identifies Pivot-RP as its replacement; preserve these discrepancies and confirm the active route with JCU Research and Innovation Services. Complete applications go through JCU Connect; where the applicant must submit electronically, JCU Connect must check and endorse first, with a final hard copy also lodged. Hard copies should be sent two days before the external deadline; assistance requests are due one week before the JCU internal close for Australian funders and two weeks before it for overseas funders. These are JCU-specific requirements and do not establish CHHHS access or export rights.

School/Centre/Institute processes can also apply. As rechecked 2026-10-07, the governing Administration of Research Funding policy is current, effective 2025-01-28 and due for review 2028-01-28; the status page shows no version number. Certification does not replace submission to the funder or itself trigger Research Office review; local units may add requirements. Confirm the route for each scheme.
